verdict.rationale: PlanetScale ships service tokens: they can be shown by ID, and the docs say to use them to authenticate the hosted MCP server for CI and headless agents. That covers issuing dedicated non-user credentials for an agent. Nothing in the pack says these tokens can be limited to specific permissions, databases or branches, so the least-privilege part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented per-token permission scopes (e.g. database/branch/action-level), read-only or least-privilege token examples for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
